parameters.content:
## Coordinator
TESTE workflow. Import inactive.

Runs the three read-only morning reports in order and writes one dry-run log. It does not run the address webhook.

Leave this inactive together with the three report workflows, or a later activation would read StarShipIt twice.

No labels. No StarShipIt writes. Telegram disabled.
